kuse.title: Kuse Prompt Builder

welcome.title: Not sure which AI to use?
welcome.subtitle: Tell us what you need — quickly find the right tools to teach, prepare, or learn

role.title: Who is this prompt for?
role.subtitle: Choose the role that matches this task.
role.teacherHint: Teaching materials, lessons, slides, and websites
role.adminHint: Notices, meetings, workflows, slides, and websites

task.title: What do you want Kuse to create?
task.subtitle: Pick a type, then write only one sentence.
task.label: One-line task (required)
task.teacherPlaceholder: e.g. Create a Grade 8 science worksheet about buoyancy with 15 questions and explanations
task.adminPlaceholder: e.g. Turn the field trip notes into a concise parent information website

materials.title: What should Kuse work from?
materials.subtitle: Choose what you have, choose no material, or simply skip this step.
materials.label: Material note (optional)
materials.placeholder: e.g. Book 3, Chapter 2; use the attached PDF and keep all dates exactly as written
materials.noMaterialHint: No problem. Kuse can start a general draft and leave school-specific facts as placeholders.

specs.title: Add anything useful
specs.subtitle: Everything on this page is optional. If needed, Kuse can ask once.
specs.adminAudience: e.g. parents, all staff, new teachers
specs.extraPlaceholder: e.g. Use only supplied facts; include placeholders for missing information

advanced.title: More optional settings
advanced.hint: Style, format, tone, required items, and other limits

visual.stylePlaceholder: e.g. Warm editorial illustration, soft daylight, school blue accents
visual.contentPlaceholder: e.g. Three students reading under a tree; leave open space for a title

website.title: Website details
website.mvpHint: One page, 4–6 essential sections, one primary action, then share it.
website.completeHint: Deliver the usable core first, then add secondary pages or functions.
website.sizePlaceholder: e.g. One page with 4–6 essential sections
website.problemPlaceholder: e.g. Important field trip information is scattered across messages
website.actionPlaceholder: e.g. Read the schedule and submit the response form
website.stylePlaceholder: e.g. Calm, clear, mobile-first, school blue
website.contentPlaceholder: e.g. Schedule, packing list, meeting point, emergency contact
website.linksPlaceholder: e.g. Response form URL; map URL; use a marked placeholder if not ready
